_about: Labelled distress-call and message phrasings for measuring the reader (messages.js). Each item lists the claim it SHOULD read as per slot: a value, 'NOT value' for a denial, or null for nothing in that slot. 'plain' items use words the anchor lists contain; 'para' items are paraphrases the lexical matcher was never told about — the reason an embedding model is worth having. Written 2026-10-18 before any model was run, so the set was not tuned to a winner.
